integrity: The claim is derived from the finite-size fidelity inequality of arXiv:2609.15059v1 with all floors retained until the asymptotic step. No numerical experiment or inaccessible source is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The statement is conditional on a family with positive limiting rate and positive limiting relative Majorana distance.
The lower threshold is one-sided and does not establish achievability or optimality outside the bounded-weight doped-Gaussian model.
The two explicit phase formulas exclude the boundary gate densities; the robust liminf consequence does not require a limiting gate density.
title: Vanishing-error non-Gaussian gate-density threshold for fermionic codeword preparation
